course: GEST3015 Smart Materials: Structures and Properties
title: What I learned today

items.heading: L2 hybridization (Beiser 8.5)
items.text: Molecular geometry follows valence-shell overlap: sigma along the bond axis, pi parallel to it. sp3 (tetrahedral), sp2 (trigonal planar + leftover p), and sp (linear + two leftover p) are linear combinations of s and p when that mixing lowers the energy, as in CH4, C2H4 and C2H2. L2 also writes dsp3 / d2sp3 for PF5 and SF6 as geometry mnemonics.

items.heading: VSEPR vs MO / ligand-field for d-block
items.text: VSEPR and a single hybridization label are not the right language for TiO2. Ti(IV) is d0; the gap is O 2p (VB) to Ti 3d t2g (CB). e_g points at oxygen, t2g between. Use ligand-field / molecular-orbital theory, not 'd2sp3' as an electronic-structure assignment.

items.heading: Periodic table bookkeeping
items.text: Atomic numbers must be stored, not inferred from the drawn table: the detached f-block made Hf look like Z=58. Hf is 72. Block colour is the differentiating electron (s/p/d/f), not a hybridization map. Eu is an f-block lanthanide; Eu3+ is 4f6, 7F0.

items.heading: Silicon as a covalent crystal (Beiser 10.3, 10.6-10.7)
items.text: Diamond-cubic Si is four equivalent sp3 bonds, a=5.431 A, nn=2.352 A, angle 109.47 deg. The gap is indirect (VBM at Gamma, CBM along Delta toward X), Eg=1.12 eV at 300 K, so a phonon is required. ni ~ 1e10 cm^-3; Eg/kT ~ 43.

items.heading: Room temperature means occupation, not shape
items.text: kT(300 K)=25.9 meV=208 cm^-1. Orbital clouds do not change with T. Temperature enters Fermi-Dirac carrier populations (Si, TiO2), Boltzmann populations of Eu3+ 7F_J (65.7 / 32.0 / 2.2 % for J=0,1,2), and 300 K lattice constants.

items.heading: Eu3+ as a spectroscopic probe
items.text: 4f sits inside 5s/5p, so ligand field is weak and bonding is ionic — no hybrid label. 5D0 to 7F1 (590 nm, magnetic dipole) and 5D0 to 7F2 (612 nm, hypersensitive electric dipole). Thermally populated 7F1 is the basis of luminescence thermometry.
